note.p: See Ed Pope's notes: 6.4.1790 Richard Wordsworth witnessed articles of clerkship William Langhorn to James Lambert attorney / William Langhorn = Holborn 19.8.1799 Elizabeth Gurney / Law List 1800 William Langhorn attorney 15 Gloucester St, Queen Sq / Holdens Directory 1811 William Langhorn solicitor 2 Chads Row, Grays Inn Rd and 11 Holborn Court, Grays Inn / will PCC 19.8.1814 William Langhorn gent of Chads Row, dated 19.7.1814 wife Elizabeth exec, with friend John Jacobs of Grays Inn. The Wordsworth above was Richard Wordsworth attorney brother of the poet William. I haven't identified William Langhorn's birth or parentage. There was a John Langhorn attorney of Barbican 1782 Law List. Possibly (because of the Wordsworth connection to the lake District) he was related to William Langhorne DNB 1721-1772 and his brother John Langhorne DNB 1735-1779
